name: Haigh's Chocolate Frogs
about: These chocolate frogs are made in South Australia, and Haigh's is one of Adelaide's best-known chocolate makers. They are a classic local treat to bring home.
tip: Ask for insulated packaging on hot days, because the chocolate can melt on the way home.

name: South Australian Barossa Shiraz
where: National Wine Centre or East End Cellars
about: This red wine comes from the Barossa Valley, a famous wine region about an hour's drive from Adelaide. It is a good way to taste South Australia's wine culture.
tip: Entry-level and everyday bottles are good value, so you can find a nice wine without a high budget.
